name: Histogram-based Voxel Ambient Occlusion
aliases: Precomputed local histograms for ambient occlusion
definition: A histogram-based approach using precomputed intensity distributions (local histograms) for each voxel's neighborhood to modulate ambient occlusion, color bleeding, scattering, and glow effects during rendering.
summary: Histogram-based Voxel Ambient Occlusion approximates ambient occlusion and color bleeding in volume rendering by using precomputed local histograms stored in a 2D texture table, enabling real-time updates via GPU blending with minimal overhead.
